title: Nonempty opens of an integral locally algebraic scheme have its dimension
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $X$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] with a locally finite type morphism $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For every nonempty open $U\subseteq X$, one has $\dim U=\dim X$, where the dimension is topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] and $U$ has the subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology].

source.place: Tag 0A21 (lemma-dimension-locally-algebraic), proof of part (3); existing proved implementation: WeilConjectures/Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/FiniteType.lean, lines 140-161, topologicalKrullDim_opens_eq

proof.text: Choose a nonempty affine open V inside U by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Every nonempty affine open W has the same dimension as V by [lem-sc-integral-locally-algebraic-affine-opens-dimension]. The nonempty affine opens cover X. Every finite chain of irreducible closed subsets meets a member of that cover in its smallest term, and restriction preserves its strict inclusions. Thus the definition [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] gives dim X <= dim V. The inclusion V subset U gives dim V <= dim U, and U subset X gives dim U <= dim X by [lem-weil-pbc-open-subspace-dimension-monotone]. Hence dim U = dim X. This is the complete already-proved source declaration topologicalKrullDim_opens_eq; no new Lean theorem or proof hole is introduced.
